questions.description: Provide the name of your preferred GP, practice, or clinic. If you don't have a preference, let us know.
questions.title: Which GP or clinic do you want to book with?

questions.description: Let us know who the appointment is for — yourself, a child, or another person.
questions.title: Is this appointment for you or someone else?

questions.description: Briefly describe the reason for the visit, e.g. general check-up, a specific symptom, referral, prescription, etc.
questions.title: What is the appointment regarding?

questions.description: For example, as soon as possible, within the next few days, or a routine appointment within the next few weeks.
questions.title: How urgently do you need to be seen?

questions.description: Let us know if you have specific availability — e.g. mornings only, after 5pm, weekdays only, a specific date.
questions.title: Do you have a preferred date or time of day?

questions.description: Some GPs offer phone or video consultations as an alternative to visiting in person.
questions.title: Do you prefer an in-person or remote consultation?

questions.description: For example, by phone, through an online portal (such as NHS App or the practice website), or via a third-party service.
questions.title: How would you like to book the appointment?

gold.taskDescription: Book an appointment with a GP for the user.
